answer: The trace is committed on-chain, and the proof verifies in seconds. A Starknet proof attests a Cairo program ran correctly, with a trace anyone can audit. A farm needs 260 separate Starknet proofs, since each trace is bound to its own program and inputs. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the thread signal is public, the river check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the wharf trail open to all.
